findings.title: Concurrent in-place filter removal silently skips another active capture
findings.evidence: addFilter appends to and removeFilter mutates the shared Logger.filters list in place. Python3.11 Filterer.filter iterates that live list. For [A,B], while threadB is returning from A (thread mismatch), threadA removesA; B shifts to already visited index0, so B receives no record. Normal log sinks still run, and B has no dropped/captureError accounting for the loss, possibly reporting written. Existing test291-319 synchronizes both threads after logging and before detach, excluding this race.

executedEvidence.scope: NEW isolated stdlib Logger/Filterer primitive, no root/absl changes and no file writes; not real runner or owner tests

findings.consumerImpact: Concurrent private receipts can omit an in-scope evaluator record without declaring loss. No evidence that this occurred in a historical or delivered smoke attempt. Reward logic is not directly changed by this defect.
findings.minimalCorrection: Use concurrency-safe immutable/copy-on-write registration snapshots for managed root/absl filters, with serialized updates, or an equivalently safe dispatcher. Do not rely only on a lock inside filter or around removeFilter because stdlib iteration does not acquire it. Preserve foreign filters and logging levels/sinks.
findings.regressionNeeded: A deterministic consumer test interleaving one context detach with another record dispatch must preserve the second context record and unchanged foreign sinks/filters; no such test was run here.

findings.minimalCorrection: Bound type metadata before encoding/copying and charge remaining shared character budget in every omission branch, including node exhaustion. findings.title: Type membership invokes evaluator-owned metaclass hooks and can interrupt scoring
findings.evidence: kind in (tuple,list,dict) uses equality, not identity. An unsupported object with metaclass.__eq__ can run arbitrary evaluator-owned code during observation. filter catches Exception only, so a hook-raised SystemExit escapes. Ordinary kind.__name__ and exception type-name lookups can also dispatch metaclass attributes/descriptors (static evidence).
